item.title: Sun in Gemini: meaning and what it says about you
item.description: Sun in Gemini means the Sun was in Gemini when you were born. In astrology the Sun stands for your core self; Gemini is an air sign ruled by Mercury, curious and quick. Your curiosity is the engine; conversation is the fuel. Read more at astralroots.app
